description: Read or change device state: brightness (0–100), screen on/off, channel, or clock face. Call with no params to read current state only. Supply any params to apply changes before reading back state. Use pixoo_discover_devices first if PIXOO_IP is not yet configured.

channel.description: Switch to a channel: faces, cloud, visualizer, or custom.

clockFaceId.description: Select a clock face by ID (channel must be faces).

screen.description: Turn the display screen on or off.

name: pixoo_control_device

applied.description: Settings successfully applied in this call (e.g. "brightness:80", "screen:on"). Empty when called with no params or all changes failed. A requested setting that failed is absent here and reported in a notice instead.

brightness.description: Current brightness level (0–100). Absent when device is unreachable.

channel.description: Current channel name (faces, cloud, visualizer, or custom). Absent when device is unreachable.

clockId.description: Current clock face ID (faces channel only). Absent on other channels or when device is unreachable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_device_configured`: PIXOO_IP is not set. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Requested settings that failed, each with its failure kind and message (e.g. "brightness:80 failed (network): …"), joined by "; ". Absent when every requested setting applied.

reachable.description: True if device responded to the status read.

screenOn.description: True if the screen is on. Absent when device is unreachable.

title: pixoo_control_device
